info.title: VRMAC-LH prototype API
info.description:
**Prototype built for the SMART ERA application, September–October 2026. Sample data.**

Innovation claims implemented for real (not mocked):

The territory is the rural plateau of **Vrmac on both sides of the ridge**: every point of interest, provider,
trail segment and event belongs to a village with its municipality (Tivat or Kotor), and itineraries span villages.

1. **Validation gate** – every content item is `draft → reviewed → approved | rejected`; visitors only ever read
   `approved` rows (explicit filters + PostgreSQL row-level security on a read-only DB role).
2. **Grounded answers or refusal** – `/api/ask` retrieves only approved entries **and** checks every answer
   sentence against the cited passage; unsupported sentences are dropped and an empty answer is withheld
   with an `answer_withheld` event.
3. **Voice-first onboarding** – offline-capable recording → speech-to-text → the model drafts *title and
   description only*; price, season, capacity and accessibility are host-entered and host-confirmed →
   consent → validation queue → publish (Montenegrin + English).
4. **Events → KPIs** – every step emits a *pseudonymised* event; K01–K23 are computed nightly and published
   only after a disclosure review (k≥5 and small-cell suppression).
5. **Map & directions** – every approved item has WGS84 coordinates, GPX trails and geotagged condition reports.
6. **Interoperability** – NGSI-LD `PointOfInterest` (Smart Data Models) + DCAT-AP export.

post.summary: Sign in with e-mail and password
post.description:
Exchange sample credentials for a short-lived JWT.

The audit row for a *failed* attempt holds no e-mail address and no client address — only the
fact that a login failed, with the request id for correlation.

post.summary: Voluntary gender self-report (the only way gender_self_reported becomes true)
post.description:
Record the caller's own voluntary self-report.

``gender_self_reported`` becomes true for every one of the four answers — including
``prefer_not_to_say``, which is an answer, not silence. Only the values in
``models.GENDER_REPORTED`` are ever disaggregated; the KPI engine excludes the rest.

get.summary: Villages of the territory (public reference data) with their approved-item counts
get.description:
Every village, optionally restricted to one municipality.

Unverified villages are **not** hidden: they are returned with ``facts_verified=false`` and a
``verification_note``, which is what the UI needs in order to mark them.

post.summary: Upload Audio
post.description:
Upload a recording and transcribe it.

The PWA may record offline (IndexedDB) and upload later: it then sends ``offline_captured=true``
and ``captured_at``, and the API stores how long the recording waited (``upload_deferred_seconds``).
The audio file is deleted as soon as it is transcribed unless ``KEEP_AUDIO=true``.

schema.title: Response Upload Audio Api Onboarding Sessions  Session Id  Audio Post

post.description: A typed transcript (no microphone), or the host's correction of the machine transcript.

schema.title: Response Set Transcript Api Onboarding Sessions  Session Id  Transcript Post

post.summary: Generate Draft
post.description:
Draft the **title and description only** from the host's own words.

``fields_required`` lists the structured fields the host must still fill in and confirm: price,
season, capacity, accessibility, coordinates, category and village. The model never fills them.

schema.title: Response Generate Draft Api Onboarding Sessions  Session Id  Draft Post

post.description: Consent + host-confirmed fields → a listing in ``draft`` (i.e. in the validation queue).

post.summary: Move an item through the gate (draft → reviewed → approved | rejected)
post.description:
Perform one transition.

Roles come from ``services.validation.TRANSITIONS`` (403 when the actor's role may not do it),
the step itself must exist (409), a listing needs a consent record before approval (409) and an
item whose facts are unverified is refused approval (409). The transition writes provenance and
audit rows, updates the RAG index and emits ``entry_approved`` / ``item_rejected``.

schema.title: Response Transition Api Validation Items  Item Type   Item Id  Transition Post

get.description:
Points for approved heritage entries and listings, LineStrings for approved trail segments.

Every feature carries its village and municipality, the ``coords_approximate`` flag and both
Google Maps navigation links. Trail features additionally carry the GPX URL, the villages they
connect and the latest **approved** condition report.

get.summary: Google Maps navigation deep link for a destination
get.description: The deep link the "how to get there" button opens — real Google routing, no API key.

get.summary: Approved trail segments with their latest condition report
get.description: Every approved segment, its ``village_slugs`` and its latest **approved** condition report.

parameters.description: village slug or id (matches any village the trail connects)

get.summary: One approved trail segment with its approved reports
get.description: 404 unless the segment is approved. ``reports`` are approved reports, newest first.

get.summary: GPX track of an approved trail segment
get.description:
The surveyed seed file when the segment references one, otherwise a track generated from the
stored geometry. Both are GPX 1.1 and both are approximate in this prototype.

post.summary: Submit a geotagged condition report (goes to the validation queue)
post.description:
Create the report as a **draft** and emit ``trail_report`` (pseudonymised, with coordinates).

Anyone may report: an anonymous visitor identified only by a random client id, or a signed-in
host/ambassador/validator. Nothing is published until the validation gate approves it.

get.description: Heritage kinds and listing categories, with the localised label used for ``why``.

Send a request to a provider
post.description: 404 unless the listing is approved — a draft listing cannot receive requests.

get.summary: Approved POIs as normalized NGSI-LD PointOfInterest entities
get.description:
Normalized NGSI-LD list (``Property``/``GeoProperty``/``Relationship`` + ``@context``).

Ready for ``POST /ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/upsert`` on an NGSI-LD context broker.
Every entity carries its village (``address.addressLocality``) and municipality
(``address.addressRegion``).

get.summary: Approved POIs as NGSI-LD key-values entities (schema-validated)
get.description:
Key-values form; ``X-Schema-Valid`` says whether every entity validates against the
vendored Smart Data Models PointOfInterest schema.

get.summary: DCAT-AP dataset description of the NGSI-LD export (JSON-LD)
get.description:
DCAT-AP ``dcat:Dataset`` for the two NGSI-LD distributions.

Carries the same ``X-Schema-Valid`` verdict as the data endpoints it describes, so a harvester
never advertises a dataset whose entities do not validate.

AuditRow.description: An audit row. ``detail`` never contains personal data (see app/audit.py).

file.title: File

offline_captured.title: Offline Captured
offline_captured.description: recorded without connectivity, kept in IndexedDB

captured_at.title: Captured At
captured_at.description: ISO 8601 — when the recording was made

GenderSelfReportIn.title: GenderSelfReportIn
GenderSelfReportIn.description:
Voluntary self-report. Extra fields (a user id, an e-mail…) are rejected on purpose:
nobody may report a gender *for* somebody else.

HeartbeatIn.title: HeartbeatIn
HeartbeatIn.description: One heartbeat of ACTIVE authoring time. A single delta is capped so a stuck tab cannot inflate it.

village.title: Village
village.description: village slug or id — every entry belongs to a village

source.title: Source
source.description: required citation for the facts of this entry

facts_verified.title: Facts Verified
facts_verified.description: false marks facts that could not be checked; such an entry can never be approved

HeritageCreateIn.title: HeritageCreateIn
HeritageCreateIn.description: New entry. It is always created in ``draft``: nothing enters the site without validation.

HeritageUpdateIn.title: HeritageUpdateIn
HeritageUpdateIn.description: Partial edit. Any edit bumps the version; an approved entry drops back to draft.

ItemView.title: ItemView
ItemView.description: One item in any status, with its full provenance trail.

ItineraryIn.title: ItineraryIn
ItineraryIn.description: What the visitor asks for: interests, available hours, where they start, which villages.

KpiRow.title: KpiRow
KpiRow.description: One published (or suppressed) cell. Carries no session, device or user identifier.

ListingIn.title: ListingIn
ListingIn.description: The host's own listing. Structured fields are entered here and listed in ``confirmed_fields``.

ListingUpdateIn.title: ListingUpdateIn
ListingUpdateIn.description:
Partial edit by the owning host (or an ambassador helping them).

Every structured field is optional and **host-entered**; sending one is the host confirming it.
Any edit bumps the version and returns the listing to ``draft`` for re-validation.

QueueItem.title: QueueItem
QueueItem.description: One row of the validator's queue (docs/api-contract.md § validation).

SupportResult.title: SupportResult
SupportResult.description: Verdict of the per-sentence attributability check (claim 2b).

TrailReportIn.title: TrailReportIn
TrailReportIn.description: A geotagged condition report: which segment (path), which point (lat/lng), what state.

VillageCounts.title: VillageCounts
VillageCounts.description: Approved items of a village, by type (the validation gate applies to all three).

VillageWithCounts.title: VillageWithCounts
VillageWithCounts.description: ``VillageOut`` plus the approved-content counters of the contract.

VisitEventIn.title: VisitEventIn
VisitEventIn.description: A visitor's position ping. No free text, no identifier that survives in the clear.
